player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Son of Yoda''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.

starting.card: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince

description: This is an Agents of the Black Sun deck that drains, battles, and causes direct damage.  All without Emperor Palpatine.
cards: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince

posted: Cloud City East Platform (Docking Bay)

notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor (posted 'Prince Xixor (at Imperial City)'), Prepared Defenses (posted 'Prepared Defenses for'), Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Mobilization Points; these count toward the 60. The strategy says the third effect varies (Do They Have A Code Clearance? or There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement instead of Crush The Rebellion).
The deck has two Prince Xizor: the starting one and one more under Characters ('Only one more Xixor?').
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the author says he tweaked the deck after Coruscant came out, and it uses Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Coruscant set).

Posted 'Do They Have A Code Clearence?' dested the Coruscant-set Effect Do They Have A Code Clearance?, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield; 'Coruscant' dested the Special Edition Coruscant (Dark); 'Death Star Docking Bay 327' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Vibro-Ax' dested Vibro-Ax (Dark) (for Snoova).
Posted 'Prince Xixor', 'The Emporer', 'Zuchuss In Mist Hunter' and 'Boba Fett In Slave 1' dested Prince Xizor, The Emperor, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter and Boba Fett In Slave I.
The author says he played it in two local tournaments (2-1, then 3-0); no event is named, so the deck stays general.
